the use of EVs in small energy systems with high shares of RES can contribute to the reduction of primary and non-renewable energy consumption and CO2 emissions, although the benefits depend on the EV recharging strategies.

EVs can contribute to reduce the primary energy consumption and CO2 emissions of an island, but only if the recharging is done during the night, when there is an excess of renewable energy in the grid, which is the case of the Flores island.
